subject: general
question: Ustad Mohi Bahauddin Dagar is a legendary musician associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudra Veena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Mohi Bahauddin Dagar **is the son of renowned **North Indian musician Zia Mohiuddin Dagar,** he plays the **Rudra veena.**
 
• He performs** Dagarbani-style Rudra veena.**
 
• Referring to **Nayak Haridas Dagar of the 16th century, he represents the 20th generation of the Dagar dynasty.**
 
• He received the highest honour for **performing artists in 2012** when the **Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for** **Music, Dance, and Drama, presented him with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Large plucked string instruments, such as the **Rudra veena, **are employed in Hindustani classical music, particularly dhrupad.
 
• It is one of the main veena varieties used in Indian classical music and is distinguished by its powerful bottom resonance. 
 
• The Rudra veena achieved great importance among Mughal court musicians, and it is documented in court records as early as** Zain-ul Abidin's (1418–1470) reign.**
